standard.caption: Input tokens enter the block through a shared embedding layer.
Queries, keys and values are projected in parallel branches.
Scaled dot-product attention mixes information across tokens.
Attention heads are concatenated and re-projected.
A residual connection and layer norm stabilise the output.
A CNN stem extracts local features from the raw image.
Patches are embedded and passed through transformer layers.
Local and global branches process complementary information.
Enhanced locality modules fuse the two feature streams.
The fused representation feeds the final classification head.
Sequence embeddings are computed from the raw amino-acid chain.
Evolutionary and structural features are extracted in parallel.
A recycling loop iteratively refines the pairwise representation.
Coordinates are predicted from the refined representation.
A final relaxation step resolves steric clashes.
